---
name: I measured my television
about: Share the answers the installation screen found, so nobody repeats the work
title: "[profile] MAKE MODEL"
labels: profile
---

Thank you — this is the most useful thing this project can receive.

A pull request with the file is even better than an issue:

```bash
tv-profile save        # on the box: writes profiles/<MAKE>_<MODEL>.json
```

Otherwise paste it here, along with:

- the television's make and model as written on the label;
- anything surprising you had to do (a menu setting, a particular HDMI socket,
  turning quick-start off);
- whether the set comes back on the right channel by itself.
